description: This file implements a remote key management device for Android's hardware security module, providing functions for key generation, import, upgrade, deletion, and retrieval of key characteristics and root of trust, utilizing the keymaster API and aidl interfaces.

classes.name: RemoteKeyMintDevice
classes.description: A class representing a remote implementation of a key mint device, providing cryptographic key management functionalities.

methods.name: convertKeyCharacteristics
methods.description: Converts key parameters and authorization sets into key characteristics, handling different security levels and enforcement tags.

methods.name: getHardwareInfo
methods.description: Retrieves hardware information about the remote key mint device.

methods.name: addRngEntropy
methods.description: Adds entropy to the device's random number generator.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key with specified parameters and optional attestation.

methods.name: importKey
methods.description: Imports a key into the device with specified parameters and optional attestation.

methods.name: importWrappedKey
methods.description: Imports a wrapped key into the device, unwrapping it with provided materials.

methods.name: upgradeKey
methods.description: Upgrades an existing key with new parameters.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key identified by its blob.

methods.name: deleteAllKeys
methods.description: Deletes all keys managed by the device.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Begins an operation with a specified purpose and key.

methods.name: deviceLocked
methods.description: Locks the device, optionally with a timestamp token.

methods.name: earlyBootEnded
methods.description: Indicates that early boot has ended.

methods.name: convertStorageKeyToEphemeral
methods.description: Converts a storage key to an ephemeral key (not implemented).

methods.name: getKeyCharacteristics
methods.description: Retrieves characteristics of a key given its blob.

methods.name: getRootOfTrustChallenge
methods.description: Retrieves a challenge for root of trust (not implemented).

methods.name: getRootOfTrust
methods.description: Retrieves the root of trust, given a challenge.

methods.name: sendRootOfTrust
methods.description: Sends root of trust data (not implemented).
